newsitem.title: USA: X-Rite names Mathew Peabody as president.
newsitem.headline: X-Rite names Mathew Peabody as president.

text.p: X-Rite Inc, which makes quality control instruments for companies in the paint, plastic textile, packaging and graphic arts industries, said Monday it appointed C. Mathew Peabody as president and chief operating officer.
Peabody, 45, will oversee day to day management of the company with special focus on the company's expanding operations in Europe and the Pacific Rim, X-Rite said.
Peabody succeeds Ted Thompson, who remains chairman and chief executive officer. He will concentrate on strategic planning, acquisitions and new technological opportunities.
Peabody had been president of Perrigo International, a unit of Perrigo Co.
X-Rite's instruments measure color and appearance.
